class.name: VideoPresetSettings
class.brief_description: Settings resource of [VideoPresetSettingsServer]: the name of the chosen graphics preset.
class.description: The data of the settings domain [code]"video_preset"[/code]. [VideoPresetSettingsServer] keeps three copies of it (defaults, applied and pending values, see [method SettingsServer.get_settings]) and stores it in [code]user://settings/video_preset.ini[/code]. The values of the preset itself are stored by the video domains ([RenderQualitySettingsServer], [VideoTextureSettingsServer], [VideoShadowSettingsServer], [VideoEffectSettingsServer]), so a [code]"Custom"[/code] state keeps its values without duplicates. Change the preset with [method VideoPresetSettingsServer.apply_preset], not on the resource.

members.member: The name of the preset the player picked, [code]"Custom"[/code] after a change of a single value, or empty if no preset was picked yet (then [method VideoPresetSettingsServer.get_current_preset] detects it from the values).
